posts.text: WAWI: Wallenius Wilhelmsen signs USD 1bn in contracts with leading equipment manufacturer Close i dag kl. 07:00 ∙ Oslo Børs Wallenius Wilhelmsen Wallenius Wilhelmsen has entered into two three-year contracts with a leading equipment manufacturer for shipping and logistics services.   "Our long-standing relationship with the customer gives us a deep understanding of their business and evolving shipping and logistics needs. By combining the scale of our global network with reliable capacity and operational flexibility, we are well positioned to support their global supply chain," says John Felitto, Chief Customer Officer at Wallenius Wilhelmsen.  The total contract value is in excess of USD 1bn over the three-year period. The shipping element of the contract is valued at about USD 950m, with rates at similar levels as the previous three-year contract.   The estimated contract value for the logistics contract is close to USD 100m over the same period.
